title: The Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation in conformal variables for waves over topography
summary: The conformal mapping approach is a well established technique for solving the Euler equations for potential flows with one spatial dimension. In this work, we extend this framework to problems with a weakly transversal dependence and, by means of asymptotic expansions, obtain a Kadomtsev-Petviashvili type equation formulated in conformal variables as a model for weakly transversal surface waves propagating over topography.
